name: summary
sql: CREATE TABLE summary (as_of TEXT, conflict TEXT, party TEXT, category_name TEXT, destroyed INTEGER, damaged INTEGER, abandoned INTEGER, captured INTEGER, total INTEGER)

name: proofs
sql: CREATE TABLE proofs (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, proof TEXT UNIQUE)

name: loss_item
sql: CREATE TABLE loss_item (as_of TEXT, conflict TEXT, party TEXT, category_name TEXT, type_name TEXT, loss_id INTEGER, loss_type TEXT, proof_id INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (proof_id) REFERENCES proofs(id))
